text: The Senior Project Manager, Facilities Plan, Strategic Project Implementation and Community Engagement, Parks and Recreation and the Senior Project Manager, Parkland Strategy, Strategic Project Implementation and Community Engagement, Parks and Recreation will give a presentation on the Parkland Strategy and the Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan. The purpose of the presentation is to receive feedback that will inform new Parkland Strategy and Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan. The presentation includes an introduction to the strategies, how communities are being engaged, what we’ve heard, emerging directions and next steps.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
